[slide 1]
DHCS (DA HU CLOUD  SYSTEM)    DATASHEET
Overview
DHCS is an independently developed solution by HOHUNET, designed for enterprise networks, campus networks, and SMB network environments. It provides comprehensive management functionalities—from ZTP (Zero Touch Provisioning) deployment to device onboarding, device monitoring, remote configuration and maintenance, OTA upgrades, panel simulation, configuration rollback, and template-based configuration.

Support ZTP management and launch
Automatic topo discovery and drawing
Simulation panel control and monitoring
Support both multi-organization mode and single-organization mode simultaneously
Version: V1.0Release Date: 2025/12/31
Graphical simulation panel
DHCS adopts a graphical simulation panel for operation, providing customers with an unparalleled operational experience.

[slide 2]
Automatic TOPO discovery and drawing
DHCS automatically discovers network nodes based on the neighbor discovery protocol and automatically generates a network topology map.
Multi-network domain management
DHCS supports multi-domain network management and assigns different management permissions to different network domains.

[slide 3]
Intelligent POE Network Energy Management and Control
Support the energy planning function and provide programmable capabilities for the POE energy network.
